question: Should this PR’s stricter fail-closed terminal and malformed-event behavior replace the existing Responses transport behavior once exact-head checks and real-provider proof are available?
rationale: The change intentionally alters failure behavior in a shared provider runtime, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision on the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Require live proof and green exact-head CI
options.body: Obtain a redacted real Responses-stream transcript or runtime log for the affected path and resolve the current exact-head check failures before approving the consolidation.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed change with documented risk
options.body: Approve the stricter behavior without additional provider proof if the owner explicitly accepts potential failures from providers that emit malformed or incomplete streams.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and green exact-head CI
recommendation.body: Obtain a redacted real Responses-stream transcript or runtime log for the affected path and resolve the current exact-head check failures before approving the consolidation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged baseline and current implementation history both connect this contributor directly to the affected stream-processing design.
